    ExtriangulatedRealization.proposition_4_4

    Proposition 4.4: the structure of C(D) #

    C(D) is idempotent complete and Krull–Schmidt; its indecomposables are, up to isomorphism, the pairwise nonisomorphic single objects X, Y, A i, P i, each with endomorphism ring k; the extension spaces between them are given by (4.1); C(D) has enough injectives; and E² = 0.
